Ærø is a Danish municipality evaluated in the 2022–2023 Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK), published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1]. The report benchmarks clinical quality in atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, utilizing data from the Danish National Patient Register (LPR) and the Danish Stroke Registry (DanStroke) [^src1]. 

Within this framework, Ærø's data concerning stroke (apopleksi) events among atrial fibrillation patients is incorporated into the calculations for Indicator 5, which tracks the prevention of ischemic strokes via anticoagulant (AK) treatment [^src1]. The municipality's specific statistical performance metrics for this indicator are detailed in a comprehensive tabular breakdown on page 95 of the report [^src1]. Because the source document references Ærø exclusively within this single tabular context, further details regarding local clinical initiatives, specific patient outcomes, or historical trends are not available in the provided corpus.
